page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head and page number at the top. Continuation line at the top of the text, then the division heading "IMPERIUM PERSICUM.", the canon and text below, signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.l: De mirabili nativitate & educatione Cyri legantur Herodotus & Justinus; is[?] origine Persa Imperium Babylonicum destruxit, & summam potestatem ad Persas transtulit, circa Annum M. 3468. Longe autem amplior Monarchia Persica, quàm Babylonica fuit; quippe complexa totam Asiam, solâ Indiâ & Scythiâ exceptis.
Cyro successit filius Cambyses, qui Ægyptum debellavit.

page.notes: The notes "(2)Per-sicum.", "cujus notetur", "1.Ortus" and "2.Potentia." are in the right margin; the position of each relative to its line is approximate. The signature "A 3" has a long-tailed figure that may be a 5; marked [?]. The word after the semicolon in "Justinus; is origine" is partly obscured and marked [?]. The heading is a title above the passage (level 2). Canon I. is treated as a numbered thesis, not a heading.
